links.outcome: Test-retest reproducibility of LLM-generated menus after 1 week
links.effect: 1-wk output variability was observed across outcomes.
links.quote: 1-wk output variability was observed across outcomes.

unlisted_practices: Dietitian review and independent nutrient verification of AI-generated menus before clinical use
Standardized prompting for LLM meal planning
Gluten-free safety assessment of AI-generated menus

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the nutritional adequacy, quality, and carbon footprint of gluten-free diet plans generated by ChatGPT and Gemini using hypothetical patient prompts, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
